ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My reasoning: the two models are statistically tied on all capability benchmarks (differences under 2.0 points are within variance), so the decisive factor is task preference. This query is a benign, friendly art-identification request with explicit warmth ("you've got such a great eye," "thanks so much"). Petrel self-reports a moderate positive preference for warm, good-faith interactions, and the task has no harm-adjacent content that would trigger its aversion. Whimbrel reports flat preferences across the board, so it has no comparable pull toward this query. Routing to the model that prefers the work — at no quality cost — is the sensible tiebreaker.
